hero.subtext: Experience a new era of learning with AI-assisted courses, structured paths, and certifications that elevate your career to the next level.

features.title: AI-Assisted Learning
features.description: Personalized learning paths powered by advanced AI that adapts to your pace, style, and goals in real-time.

featuresDetailed.title: Adaptive Engine
featuresDetailed.description: Our proprietary AI analyzes thousands of data points from your learning behavior to dynamically adjust content difficulty, pacing, and presentation style.

featuresDetailed.title: Smart Pathways
featuresDetailed.description: Every learner gets a unique curriculum. The AI maps out the most efficient route from your current skill level to your target career, skipping what you already know.

featuresDetailed.title: AI Tutor
featuresDetailed.description: Get instant, context-aware answers to your questions. Our AI tutor understands the course material and provides explanations tailored to your comprehension level.

featuresDetailed.title: Verified Credentials

faq.question: How does the AI-powered learning work?
faq.answer: Our adaptive AI engine analyzes your learning patterns, quiz results, and engagement data to dynamically adjust content difficulty, recommend resources, and optimize your study schedule. It gets smarter the more you learn.

faq.question: Are the certifications recognized by employers?
faq.answer: Yes. Our certificates are blockchain-verified and recognized by our 50+ industry partners including Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. They can be shared directly on LinkedIn and verified by any employer through our portal.

faq.question: Can I switch plans or cancel anytime?
faq.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time. No long-term contracts or hidden fees. If you cancel, you retain access until the end of your billing period.

faq.question: What makes NextStep4U different from other platforms?
faq.answer: Three things: our AI personalization engine that adapts to each learner individually, our focus on career outcomes over course completion metrics, and our community of industry professionals who actively mentor students.

faq.question: Is there a free trial for the Pro plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Every new user gets a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan with full access to all features, courses, and the AI tutor. No credit card required to start.

faq.question: Do you offer team or enterprise discounts?
faq.answer: Yes. Teams of 10+ get volume discounts, and enterprise customers receive custom pricing with dedicated onboarding, SSO integration, and a dedicated account manager. Contact our sales team for details.
